metadata.platform: AMD AMD Instinct MI300X VF (206 GB HBM3)
metadata.method: PySCF CASCI + JW + GPU exact diag + custom GPU VQE (autograd+LBFGS)
metadata.honest_accuracy_note: All 'accuracy' claims refer to ALGORITHMIC accuracy (VQE vs exact diagonalization of the same model Hamiltonian), NOT accuracy against experimental measurements or CBS limit. Basis set incompleteness errors are quantified via CBS extrapolation.
